projects.description:
An onboarding flow and daily overview explore readable typography, clear touch targets and a compact navigation system.

Help people organise daily priorities with fewer screens and distractions. The proposed scope includes onboarding, daily overview, saved items and notification preferences.

This sample case study demonstrates how a completed project can be presented. The figures and client are illustrative, and the video is placeholder footage.
